The '''Skirmish near Kessel''' occurred when a small [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet tried to prevent the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Invids]] from stealing a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] shipment in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] in 11 ABY.
